description:
One obligation in the flat KG the reference runtime loads.

``predicate`` is left an open string, exactly as the runtime's own
structured-output grammar declares it (``{"type": "string"}``), so a
KG carrying an implementation-extension predicate (e.g.
``must_average_within``) is still valid. The closed base enumeration is
spec §3.3 (``ObligationType`` in ``kg_validator.models``).

Unknown members are permitted (``additionalProperties`` stays open): the
KG format is extensible and the runtime ignores members it does not read.

effective_date.description: ISO-8601 date or datetime; the obligation is out of scope before this instant.
effective_date.title: Effective Date

id.description: Stable obligation identifier, unique within the KG.
id.title: Id

jurisdiction.description: Jurisdiction the obligation applies to, or a universal sentinel ('global', '*', ''). Absent means universal.
jurisdiction.title: Jurisdiction

metric.description: Dotted-path identifier into the measurement record's measurement object.
metric.title: Metric

predicate.description: The obligation type, drawn from spec §3.3's closed enumeration plus the runtime extensions (e.g. 'must_not_exceed', 'must_be_at_least', 'must_average_within'). Left an open string to match the runtime grammar.
predicate.title: Predicate

requires_recent_within_seconds.description: Maximum age in seconds of an acceptable reading for a recency obligation.
requires_recent_within_seconds.title: Requires Recent Within Seconds

risk_tier.description: Declared risk tier ('tier-1' strictest .. 'tier-3'). A missing or unrecognised tier resolves to 'tier-1' at runtime (fail-safe). Never a trust input the LLM controls.
risk_tier.title: Risk Tier

summary.description: Human-readable summary of the obligation, for transcripts and review UIs.
summary.title: Summary

sunset_date.description: ISO-8601 date or datetime; the obligation is out of scope after this instant.
sunset_date.title: Sunset Date

unit.description: Unit of 'value' and of the measured reading, when the obligation is unit-bearing.
unit.title: Unit

value.description: The operand the predicate is evaluated against (scalar, list, or null).
value.title: Value

window_seconds.description: Window length in seconds for a windowed predicate (e.g. a 24h rolling average).
window_seconds.title: Window Seconds

title: KGObligation
